name: re8ch-qwen-tenant-expert
description: Qwen tenant access to RE8CH container image and database runtime services.

interface.shortDescription: Run OCI images and tenant databases on RE8CH capacity.
interface.longDescription: A tenant-scoped expert for pulling digest-pinned OCI images, running ordinary container workloads, provisioning database instances, and observing or releasing only Qwen-owned resources through audited RE8CH tools.
defaultPrompt: Show the compute and database capacity available to the Qwen tenant.
Plan this container image run and show quota, placement, cost, and expiry before creating it.
Provision a tenant database and return only the approved connection reference.
